card.title: Wave-End Breather
card.pitch: Heroes recover a little health after each wave.
card.visualHook: A small healing particle burst accompanies the recovery.
acceptance: When wave_end occurs within 900 ticks, injured heroes receive a small heal.
Healthy heroes do not exceed their normal health limit.
card.feasibility: Handle wave_end, query heroes, and use bounded healing and particles.
card.risk: Low; healing is modest and limited to wave endings.
